sources.quote: Priced at just $0.25/1M input tokens and $1.50/1M output tokens, 3.1 Flash-Lite delivers enhanced performance at a fraction of the cost of larger models.
sources.supports: Google's launch announcement establishes the official input and output prices at preview launch.

sources.quote: | Context caching price | Not available | $0.025 (text / image / video) $0.05 (audio) $1.00 / 1,000,000 tokens per hour (storage price) |
sources.supports: Google's pricing table distinguishes cached-token pricing from the $1 per million tokens per hour cache storage charge, explaining the erroneous cache_write field.

notes: The official $0.25 input and $1.50 output rates were announced when Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview launched on March 3, 2026; Google also lists cached input at $0.025 and labels the $1 rate as hourly storage pricing. This supports a models.dev fix, not a provider price change; no effective change date applies.
